bullets: Lead engineering on a 10-contributor production codebase (444 of my commits): set up CI/CD deploy gates, secret scanning, coverage checks, CODEOWNERS and the contributing guide; 534 backend tests.

Traced production kiosk lag to an unbounded download pipeline (125 concurrent threads, swap 900/990 MiB on a 1 GB Raspberry Pi) and replaced it with a bounded worker pool, stale-job filtering and cache eviction, covered by 15 new regression tests.
Fixed a race that showed customers another customer's file by allocating print codes in atomic Firestore transactions and serialising print dispatch on the Pi to one job at a time.
Stopped false refunds from slow CUPS responses (lpstat timeout + retry, real failure reasons logged) and raised API capacity from 10 to 50 instances for a ~7,000 requests/hour lunch peak.
Made refunds exactly-once across 3 entry points with a shared atomic claim, and made the Cashfree payment webhook signature-verified and idempotent.
Resolved production incidents (403 upload failures, 12 lost secrets, broken Office conversion), closed an auth bypass, locked down public Firestore/Storage rules and fixed 13 audit findings.
